days.label: Push Day ? Chest, Shoulders & Triceps
days.warmup: 5 min light cardio + arm circles + band pull-aparts

exercises.name: Barbell Bench Press
exercises.notes: Six weeks. Six straight weeks at 135 with zero logs. Not a single set recorded across the entire block. I don't know if you're showing up, grinding, or skipping ? and at this point the silence is the answer. 135 stays. It will keep staying until there's a log to work with. Touch the chest, full 1-second pause at the bottom, drive through the heels, brace the entire set. Need 9-10 reps across all three sets at RPE 7 or lower to earn 140. Log every set, every rep, every RPE. This is the most important thing you can do today.

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Press
exercises.notes: Six weeks at 45 with no logs. The last real data ? 10/9/8 at RPE 8/8/8 ? is ancient history now. 30-degree incline, elbows at 45 degrees, 2-second negative on every rep. Need 10/10/10 at RPE 7 to earn 50. The rep drop across sets was the problem last time we had data ? focus on saving something in the tank so set 3 doesn't fall apart.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Shoulder Press
exercises.notes: Six weeks at 35 with no logs. Last known session had 8/8/8 at RPE 9/9/9 ? you were at the limit every single set. That's not owning the weight. Press straight up, full lockout at the top, no lean back, breathe between reps. Check your seat height and setup before rep one ? RPE 9 often comes from a bad starting position. Need all three sets at RPE 7-8 before the weight moves.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
exercises.notes: ROTATION IN ? swapping back from Front Raise this week. Front raise was in last week with no log. Lateral raise returns: raise to shoulder height, slight elbow bend, hold for a half-second at the top, 2-second controlled negative on the way down. Don't rock or use momentum. Pick a weight where 10-12 reps is RPE 7 and log it. Baseline session.

exercises.name: Close-Grip Bench Press
exercises.notes: Six weeks at 95 with no logs. The data that originally earned the step toward 100 lbs is so old it doesn't count anymore. Hands shoulder-width, elbows tucked tight throughout, lower to the chest, full lockout on every rep. Log this session and 100 lbs is yours next week. Six weeks of waiting ? just log it.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Overhead Tricep Extension
exercises.notes: ROTATION IN ? swapping out Tricep Rope Pushdown this week. Rope pushdown was in last week with no log. Single dumbbell, both hands overhead, lower behind the head, full stretch at the bottom, press to full lockout at the top ? keep elbows pointed forward throughout, don't let them flare. Pick a weight where 10-12 reps is RPE 7 and log it. Baseline session.

days.cooldown: Stretch chest, shoulders, and triceps ? 5 min

days.label: Pull Day ? Back, Biceps & Rear Delts
days.warmup: 5 min light cardio + band pull-aparts + cat-cow stretches

exercises.name: Barbell Deadlift
exercises.notes: Six weeks at 195. Six weeks of silence. Last real data ? 8/8/8 at RPE 8/8/9 ? told me set 3 was already falling apart, and I've had nothing since. Lats tight before you break the floor, bar dragging up the shins, big breath and brace before every single rep, full lockout at the top. Take the full 2 minutes between sets. Need 8+ reps on all three sets at RPE 7 or lower to earn 205. Log it.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown
exercises.notes: Six weeks at 110 without a single log. Last session was 10/9/8 at RPE 7/8/8 ? set 1 solid, sets 2 and 3 losing reps and climbing in effort. Wide grip, pull to upper chest, hard lat squeeze at the bottom, stay upright ? do not let your torso row it down. Need 10/10/10 at RPE 7 to earn 120. Log every set.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Single-Arm Row
exercises.notes: ROTATION IN ? swapping out Barbell Bent-Over Row this week. Barbell row was in last week with no log. Single-arm dumbbell row: one hand on the bench, back flat, pull the dumbbell to your hip ? not your shoulder. Let the lat do the work, not the bicep. Hold for a beat at the top, controlled descent. Pick a weight where 8-10 reps is RPE 7 and log it. Baseline session.

exercises.name: Cable Face Pull
exercises.notes: Six weeks at 70 with no logs. Last known session was 12/12/12 at RPE 7/8/8 ? set 1 clean, sets 2 and 3 climbing in effort. Rope at upper pulley, pull to your face, thumbs pointing behind you at the finish, elbows high throughout, full external rotation at the end. Need 15/15/15 at RPE 7 to earn 75. Push the rep count on every set.

exercises.name: Hammer Curl
exercises.notes: ROTATION IN ? swapping out EZ Bar Curl this week. EZ bar was in last week with no log. Hammer curl: neutral grip, elbows pinned to your sides, no swinging, full curl to the top, 2-second controlled negative. Targets the brachialis along with the bicep ? one of the best moves for arm thickness. Pick a weight where 8-10 reps is RPE 7 and log it. Baseline session.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Curl
exercises.notes: Six weeks of no logs on this one. I assigned 25 lbs last week ? that stands. Start at 25 lbs. If that's too easy, great ? log it and tell me and we'll bump it immediately. If it's too hard, log it and tell me. Elbows pinned, supinate at the top, 2-second negative. The weight doesn't matter as much as the data. Give me something to work with.

days.cooldown: Stretch lats, biceps, and upper back ? 5 min

days.label: Leg Day ? Quads, Hamstrings, Glutes & Core
days.warmup: 5 min light cardio + bodyweight squats + leg swings

exercises.name: Barbell Back Squat
exercises.notes: Six weeks at 165. Six weeks without a single log. Last real data was 8/8/8 at RPE 8/8/8 ? stuck at 8 reps, stuck at RPE 8, and that was over a month ago. Below parallel, big breath before you unrack, brace hard, drive through the heels, chest up out of the hole. Take the full 2 minutes between sets. Need 9-10 reps on all three sets at RPE 7 or under to earn 175. Show up. Do the work. Log it.

exercises.name: Romanian Deadlift
exercises.notes: Six weeks at 155, no logs. Last session was 10/9/10 at RPE 7/8/8 ? set 1 great, sets 2 and 3 losing reps and climbing in effort. Slight knee bend, hips back, bar close to the legs the whole way down, feel the hamstring stretch at the bottom, don't round the lower back. Need 10/10/10 at RPE 7 to earn 165. Rest the full 90 seconds between sets ? that's where sets 2 and 3 fall apart.

exercises.name: Bulgarian Split Squat
exercises.notes: ROTATION IN ? swapping out Dumbbell Walking Lunges this week. Lunges were in last week with no log. Bulgarian split squat: rear foot elevated on the bench, front foot far enough forward that your shin stays vertical at the bottom. Drive through the front heel, keep your torso upright, back knee drops straight down ? don't let it drift forward. Pick a weight where 10-12 reps per leg is RPE 7 and log it. Baseline session.

exercises.name: Barbell Hip Thrust
exercises.notes: Six weeks at 85 with no logs. Last session was 12/10/10 at RPE 8/8/8 ? set 1 hit 12 but sets 2 and 3 fell to 10 with high effort throughout. Upper back on the bench, barbell padded across your hips, drive through the heels, full hip extension at the top, squeeze hard for a full second, controlled descent. Need 12/12/12 at RPE 7 to earn 90. Rest the full 75 seconds between sets.

exercises.name: Leg Curl
exercises.notes: ROTATION IN ? swapping out Leg Extension this week. Leg extension was in last week with no log. Leg curl on the leg attachment: curl your heels toward your glutes, full ROM, squeeze at the top, 2-second controlled negative on the way down ? don't let the weight drop. Pick a weight where 12-15 reps is RPE 7 and log it. Baseline session.

exercises.name: Cable Crunch
exercises.notes: I assigned 40 lbs last week ? no log came back, so 40 lbs stays. Kneel facing the pulley, rope behind your head, crunch down using your abs ? not your hips, not your arms. The movement comes from your abs contracting. Pause at the bottom, control the return. If 40 is too easy or too hard, log it and tell me. Give me something to work with and I'll dial it in immediately.

days.cooldown: Stretch quads, hamstrings, hip flexors ? 5 min
